task.title: Build, launch and validate a fresh portable artifact from current main
task.objective: Produce a portable SpecterStudio artifact generated from the exact current main HEAD, prove its freshness with source-to-artifact evidence, launch that exact artifact, and determine definitively whether previously observed old renderer UI is caused by a stale artifact or by genuine defects in a genuinely fresh artifact.

preserved_notes: The gitignored developer launcher /run-app-demo.mjs and any untracked owner material must be preserved untouched.
Stale dist/ artifacts are generated build output. They may be labelled and superseded, but no user-authored file may be deleted.

writer.note: Packaging regenerates and Ed25519-signs the tracked dependency manifest pair at the current HEAD. Every other packaging output lands in gitignored dist/, out/, build/ and vendor/ trees that no agent owns.

architecture: Use the repository-authoritative packaging pipeline scripts/package-portable.ps1 via npm run package:portable; do not hand-invoke electron-builder to bypass a failing gate.
Do not reuse an older package after a failed packaging attempt.
security: Do not alter signing-key custody, and do not set the synced-key override; the approved non-synced key location must be used as-is.
Do not weaken manifest, provenance, fresh-state or strict-offline gates to make packaging succeed.
compatibility: Windows PowerShell 5.1 remains the packaging host shell and no administrator rights may be required.
offline: No internet dependency, telemetry, runtime download, global Node, global Playwright or global browser may be introduced.
Any commit SHA embedded for provenance must be build-time metadata only, never a network call.

acceptance.description: The application builds from the exact baseline commit with a clean typecheck.

A portable artifact is newly generated from baseline commit 9778437 and its provenance record names that exact commit, a build timestamp from this task, and a SHA-256 differing from the superseded 0.1.29 artifact.
Strict offline validation passes against the manifest regenerated at the baseline commit.

The renderer surfaces are validated from the freshly generated artifact, and each surface is reported as NEW DESIGN CONFIRMED, PARTIAL, DEFECT FOUND, NOT RUN or BLOCKED without inference from any older executable.
Authoritative roadmap sources remain consistent and the Overview banner reads Sources agree.
